purpose: Describe becoming accustomed to something through experience.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
Noun + に慣れる; verb dictionary form + のに慣れる
I got used to my new life.
I am used to getting up early.
It took time to get used to driving on the left.
formation: Noun + に慣れる; verb dictionary form + のに慣れる
restrictions: Use に慣れている for an already familiar state.
mistake: 慣れる means get used to; it is not the same as becoming skilled at everything involved.
